items_all.summary: Gemini 4 Argon于10月13日全面开放，Pro会员可在Gemini APP使用，Antigravity需100刀Ultra会员。作者实测认为其知识类专业能力强，Vals Index综合第一（68.9）且单次成本仅15.68美元，但CUA-bench仅4.83%排倒数第二；前端效果不及GPT-6 Astra，额度消耗快，中文写作味道重，整体体验糟糕，不建议订阅Ultra。

en.summary: Gemini 4 Argon became fully available on October 13. Pro members can use it in the Gemini app, while Antigravity requires the $100 Ultra membership. In the author's hands-on testing, it was strong at knowledge-heavy professional tasks, ranked first overall on Vals Index (68.9) at only $15.68 per run, but placed second-to-last on CUA-bench at just 4.83%. Its front-end results trail GPT-6 Astra, it burns through quota quickly, and its Chinese writing has a strong AI flavor. The overall experience is poor, and subscribing to Ultra is not recommended.

en.summary: Character.ai has entered bankruptcy proceedings, with court documents showing its business model could not support its expenses. The company spent $13.8 million per month on AI compute in 2024 and $10 million in 2025, while subscription revenue peaked at just $2.8 million per month and total revenue including ads peaked at $5.3 million. From January to August 2026, compute spending reached $56.1 million, and as of August it was still losing about $8-9 million per month.

en.summary: OpenAI announced that a hidden recording device was found in its office. Using its own models to analyze the device and its origins, it determined that an employee had planted it several days earlier. OpenAI has referred the matter to the FBI, which quickly arrested the individual involved; the investigation is ongoing. OpenAI said there is currently no indication that the employee improperly accessed or leaked model weights, source code, or customer data. The employee has been fired, and OpenAI is treating the case as an example of AI helping respond to complex security threats.

en.summary: The XBOW team, with help from OpenAI's GPT-5.6 Sol, built a full-chain Chrome exploit in six days using $40,000 in compute, earning a $250,000 bounty from Google. This is Google's second bounty for a full-chain Chrome exploit and the first under new 2026 rules. Chrome on Windows is affected; the authors say similar exploits used to take about six months to build, and they remind users to restart Chrome promptly when the Update button appears.

en.summary: ElevenLabs announced that Baroness Campbell of Surbiton today delivered a speech in the UK House of Lords using an AI-reconstructed voice built by the company, a first for the UK Parliament. The Baroness has spinal muscular atrophy, which affects her speech, and the AI voice replicated the tone, rhythm and pitch of her original voice. ElevenLabs says its technology has helped more than 11,000 people who lost their voice to injury or illness restore it, and has pledged to help 1 million people worldwide who have lost their voices.

en.title: Codex generates a "Claude-feel" animation skill (now open source)
en.summary: Many people ask Codex to make animations, but the camerawork, materials, and motion pacing all look like they were thrown together at the last minute. The author analyzed over 100 Claude animation source codes and, through double-blind and ablation experiments, organized the drawing code, scenes, models, and production system behind that "Claude feel" into an asset library, so that when GPT generates animations it can look up examples directly, reuse implementations, and re-adapt them into new stories.

items_all.title: 通读完13万星的REA源码，它的防幻觉设计值得每个做AI的人抄一遍
items_all.summary: REA短短一周收获了13万GitHub星标，它爆火的核心不止降低了逆向门槛，更藏着一套解决AI幻觉的优秀工程思路。不靠提示词约束大模型，而是在工具层搭建多重可信机制：事实分级标注、传输哈希校验，强制标记未知信息，矛盾结论直接拦截。一旦环境校验失败就停止工作，绝不编造虚假内容。这套架构可以迁移到MCP工具开发，给医疗、法律等高严谨场景构建可信AI系统提供可落地的参考范式。

en.title: After reading through the source code of REA, a repo with 130k stars, its anti-hallucination design is worth copying by anyone building AI
en.summary: In just one week, REA picked up 130,000 GitHub stars. What drove its rise goes beyond lowering the barrier to reverse engineering—it also carries an excellent engineering approach to tackling AI hallucinations. Instead of constraining the LLM through prompts, it builds multiple trust mechanisms at the tool layer: graded fact labeling, hash verification in transit, mandatory flagging of unknown information, and outright interception of contradictory conclusions. If environment validation fails, it stops working rather than fabricating content. This architecture can be carried over to MCP tool development, offering a practical reference model for building trustworthy AI systems in high-rigor fields like healthcare and law.

items_all.title: AI Agent 编程最大的痛点是什么？不是写不出代码，而是它每次都自信满满地声称“任务已修复”，结果一运行却发现处处都是隐蔽 Bug。现在，AI 代理终于能学会自己“闭环验牌”了。 开发者 Oskar 正式推出了全新的 /create-verification-skill。这项扩展技能的核心理念非常明确：让你的 Coding Agent 在交付代码前，必须先验证自己的工作成果，并利用 E2E（端到端测试）作为验证层，为你提供确凿的运…

items_all.title: 逐帧学习艾伦-孙哥采访视频心得： 孙哥提到“为什么大模型灌的信息越多，模型越聪明”， 他说大模型给他的答案是也不清楚，是个黑盒，但我问了一下ai，答案不是那样的（这也体现了提示词、ai模型对于回答的影响）以下是我获得的答案： 大模型为什么越“灌”信息，反而越聪明？这其实触及了人工智能最核心的问题：为什么数据积累能够转化为智能？ 关键在于，大模型会通过训练，从海量信息中提取规律，并将这些规律用于解决新的问题。 我认为可以从三个层次理解。…

en.title: Takeaways from watching the Allen-Sun Ge interview video frame by frame: Sun Ge raised the question, "Why do large models get smarter the more information you feed them?" He said the LLM's answer was that it doesn't know either — it's a black box. But when I asked an AI, the answer wasn't like that (which itself shows how prompts and AI models shape the response). Here's the answer I got: why do large models get smarter the more you "feed" them?

Today's AI Frontier Brief · October 13, 2026
Today's key developments center on disputes over the independence of safety evaluations, media copyright litigation, and commercialization: OpenAI and Anthropic are negotiating with institutions over permission to publish independent external evaluation reports; USA Today has filed a lawsuit seeking more than $250 million in damages and requesting the destruction of the relevant models; in addition, ChatGPT's free tier has begun showing ads to some users.

items_all_raw.title: Character.AI 成立五年后申请 Chapter 11 破产，部分资产以 2000 万美元出售给 Disney
items_all_raw.summary: Character.AI 已申请 Chapter 11 破产，法院文件显示其资产和负债在 5000 万至 1 亿美元之间，并同意以 2000 万美元向 Disney 出售部分资产及技术非独占永久许可。出售过程预计 11 月底或 12 月初完成，期间平台继续运营，但尚无竞购方，若无买家平台将关停；此前公司因未成年用户诉讼、德州调查等困境，曾尝试 AI 视频生成、社交信息流和微短剧等转型未果。
